podcast.title: Breaker of Mumford & Sons
podcast.body: Glassnote is an English record label credited with launching the career of Mumford & Sons, demonstrating its influence in promoting indie-folk artists to wider audiences. "the English label Glassnote, the same company that broke Mumford."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Home to Notable Indie Artists
podcast.body: Glassnote Records is an indie label that is home to several prominent artists, including Phoenix, Mumford & Sons, and Chvrches, demonstrating its standing in the independent music scene. "This is the indie label that's home to Phoenix and Mumford & Sons and Churches."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Strumbellas' Breakthrough Deal
podcast.body: Daniel Glass, who heads Glassnote Records, signed The Strumbellas after hearing samples of their third album and seeing them live. This deal was pivotal for the band, leading to a worldwide release of their "Hope" album. "But then they came to the attention of Daniel Glass at Glass Note Records. The strombellas manager made contact, sent them samples of the band's third album and waited by the phone. But then it rang. We liked the record and Daniel Glass is flying to Toronto to see the band live. Everybody got along and the deal was struck."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
